## About This Project

This project investigates putting performance among professional golfers on the PGA Tour. By analyzing tournament-level ShotLink data, we explore how putting proficiency varies across professional players and compare the top 25 overall golfers to the wider tour.

## About the Author

This project was created for a final project in statistics.

You can find the code repository for this project on GitHub: [milestone-4](https://github.com/Bsteffen11/milestone-4).
